title: Regression: `add-topo` fails `testbed_config_vchassis.yml` with `ERROR! Specified hosts and/or --limit does not match any hosts`
author: arista-nwolfe
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Previous Working Version

Introduced by https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/17647

### Steps to Reproduce

In https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/17647 `add-topo` was updated with a new ansible playbook call on T2 topologies:
```
    if [[ $topo == *"t2"* ]]; then
      ansible-playbook -i ${inv_name} testbed_config_vchassis.yml --vault-password-file="$passfile" -l "$duts" -e testbed_name="$testbed_name" \
      -e topo="$topo" -e testbed_file=$tbfile -e vm_file=$vmfile  -e server="$server" $@
    fi
```

This playbook fails with:
```
ansible-playbook 2.8.20
  config file = /data/ansible/ansible.cfg
  configured module search path = [u'/data/ansible/library', u'/data/ansible/library/ixia']
  ansible python module location = /usr/local/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/ansible
  executable location = /usr/local/bin/ansible-playbook
  python version = 2.7.18 (default, Dec  9 2024, 19:35:20) [GCC 9.4.0]
Using /data/ansible/ansible.cfg as config file
host_list declined parsing /data/ansible/lab as it did not pass it's verify_file() method
script declined parsing /data/ansible/lab as it did not pass it's verify_file() method
auto declined parsing /data/ansible/lab as it did not pass it's verify_file() method
Parsed /data/ansible/lab inventory source with ini plugin
[WARNING]: Could not match supplied host pattern, ignoring: server_1
ERROR! Specified hosts and/or --limit does not match any hosts
```

I think the problem may be that only the `-i ${inv_name}` inventory file is included and not `-i $vmfile`.
At least on our setup it seems like `server_1` is defined in the `$vmfile` and not `${inv_name}`.

### Impact of this regression

`add-topo` stage fails, can't setup sonic-mgmt infra.

comments.author: BYGX-wcr
comments.body: Hi @arista-nwolfe, I don't get the point that you indicated. The ansible command runs with `-l "$duts"`. So, the host limit should be applied to the DUTs instead of the servers. How can the "$duts" get interpreted as "server_1" in your lab?

comments.author: arista-nwolfe
comments.body:
> Hi [@arista-nwolfe](https://github.com/arista-nwolfe), I don't get the point that you indicated. The ansible command runs with `-l "$duts"`. So, the host limit should be applied to the DUTs instead of the servers. How can the "$duts" get interpreted as "server_1" in your lab?

Hi @BYGX-wcr the problem is the extra arguments passed into `testbed-cli.sh`.
In Arista's case we call `testbed-cli.sh` with the following arguments:
`cd /data/ansible;./testbed-cli.sh -k ceos add-topo ardut  password.txt -l server_1 -vvv`

By time we get into `add_topo` we've shifted the `$@` arguments to the last 2 arguments.
`echo "NATHAN: $@"` returns `NATHAN: -l server_1 -vvv`

So because the call to `testbed_config_vchassis.yml` has `$@` on the end of the command
```
ansible-playbook -i ${inv_name} testbed_config_vchassis.yml --vault-password-file="$passfile" -l "$duts" -e testbed_name="$testbed_name" \
-e topo="$topo" -e testbed_file=$tbfile -e vm_file=$vmfile  -e server="$server" $@
```
We'll end up passing two limit arguments in the same call:
`-l $duts` and `-l server_1`

I tried this out on my server and I see that it's skipped because no hosts matched
```
ansible-playbook -i lab testbed_config_vchassis.yml --vault-password-file="" -l "nfc406-7,nfc406-9,nfc406" -e testbed_name="ardut" -e topo="t2_2lc_min_ports-masic" -e testbed_file=testbed.yaml -e vm_file=veos -e server="server_1" -l server_1 -vvv
/usr/local/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/ansible/parsing/vault/__init__.py:44: CryptographyDeprecationWarning: Python 2 is no longer supported by the Python core team. Support for it is now deprecated in cryptography, and will be removed in the next release.
  from cryptography.exceptions import InvalidSignature
ansible-playbook 2.8.20
  config file = /sonic-mgmt/ansible/ansible.cfg
  configured module search path = [u'/sonic-mgmt/ansible/library', u'/sonic-mgmt/ansible/library/ixia']
  ansible python module location = /usr/local/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/ansible
  executable location = /usr/local/bin/ansible-playbook
  python version = 2.7.18 (default, Dec  9 2024, 19:35:20) [GCC 9.4.0]
Using /sonic-mgmt/ansible/ansible.cfg as config file
host_list declined parsing /sonic-mgmt/ansible/lab as it did not pass it's verify_file() method
script declined parsing /sonic-mgmt/ansible/lab as it did not pass it's verify_file() method
auto declined parsing /sonic-mgmt/ansible/lab as it did not pass it's verify_file() method
Parsed /sonic-mgmt/ansible/lab inventory source with yaml plugin

PLAYBOOK: testbed_config_vchassis.yml **************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
1 plays in testbed_config_vchassis.yml

PLAY [sonic] ***************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
skipping: no hosts matched
```
